question_inputs.scope: Pinned public benchmark VQA inputs for the original8 scenes; source/input preparation only, no VLM scoring or GPU/API spend

protocol.system: You are a helpful AI assistant that answers questions about videos. Answer with just YES or NO.
protocol.begin_user: I'll show you a video with several frames. Please look carefully at all frames to understand what's happening in the video, then answer the question about the video with either YES or NO.
protocol.question_suffix: Please answer with YES or NO.
protocol.question_mode: Original single question per generation, answers/uid/method labels not included in model prompt
protocol.video_metadata: Original fps/indices/total frame count passed explicitly; CPU verified actual timestamped input
protocol.arm_order: SHA256(scene) parity chooses reference/candidate first; method labels never enter prompt
protocol.answer_parser: Whole response YES/NO, optional terminal punctuation; explanations/mixed labels invalid, no silent substring match or reruns
protocol.aggregation: Questions retained per scene; equal-scene pairs, invalid answers give accuracy bounds not confidence intervals; rejected candidate no imputation, original8 denominator retained; no standard Joint
protocol.gpu_scope: Proposed one model load/all original8/42reference39acceptedcandidate questions, includes loading/checks/diagnostics/parse failures/flush under remaining original4GPUh. Not a measured cost or completed GPU test
protocol.limitation: Small development judge with sparse10frame input, not paper235B, independent confirmation, full-video physical ground truth or overall quality acceptance

summary.scope: Original scene denominator retained. Bounds account for invalid raw answers, not statistical confidence. Small reusable-CAL proxy, no physical correctness, overall quality, paper Joint, independent confirmation or clean-speed acceptance.
